scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned Solomon sits with a scroll overlooking an ancient city.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of the introduction to the proverbs of Solomon.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elder teaches an attentive young learner beside an open scroll.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The scene suggests receiving wisdom and understanding.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elder discusses fairness with two neighbors at a village gate while a young learner watches.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The scene suggests instruction in justice and fairness.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elder points down a hillside path as a young person considers the way.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The scene suggests prudence and discernment learned by a young person.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man listens to another teacher beside an open scroll.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The scene suggests the wise person listening and increasing learning.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elder speaks to a thoughtful group gathered beneath a tree.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The scene suggests listening to and considering the words of the wise.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man bows in prayer while a learner listens to an elder and another man turns away.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The scene suggests reverence, learning and the rejection of instruction.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A boy listens to his father and mother in a courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The scene suggests a son listening to his parents instruction.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling young man wears a flower and leaf garland and several gold chains in a sunlit stone courtyard, as a man rests a hand on his shoulder and a woman adjusts the garland.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 1:9, where parental instruction is likened to a graceful ornament for the head and chains about the neck.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit stone village path, a young man raises his hand in refusal as three men beckon and offer him a pouch of coins; an older man watches from a doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a son refusing enticement, reflecting the warning in Proverbs 1:10.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three men conceal themselves among rocks and shrubs beside a sunlit road, one gesturing to a young man, while a lone traveler approaches from the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the invitation to lie in wait for an innocent person without cause in Proverbs 1:11.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: On a rocky hillside at sunset, a frightened man slips toward a deep dark pit while a woman reaches for him; three threatening figures approach behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the verse’s threat to swallow people alive and whole, like those going down to the pit.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Four men carry and gather chests, textiles, jewelry, and ornate vessels inside a stone house filled with valuables.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the boast in Proverbs 1:13 about finding precious possessions and filling houses with spoil.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A hesitant young man sits beneath a tree as three men invite him into their group; one gestures toward him, another holds a leather purse, and small lots lie between them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of the invitation in Proverbs 1:14 to cast one’s lot among the group and share one purse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A father rests a hand on his son’s shoulder and speaks to him at a fork in a rocky path, while a group of men walks away along one branch. An olive tree, golden fields, stone walls, distant buildings and hills fill the landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the father’s warning in Proverbs 1:15 to keep one’s foot from the path of those who would lead him astray.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit rocky path, a frightened traveler runs while armed men pursue him, their feet kicking up dust; hills, trees, and a distant village fill the landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of armed pursuers illustrates Proverbs 1:16, where their feet run toward evil and they hurry to shed blood.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A small brown bird perched in an olive tree looks down toward a rope net spread openly across sunlit ground, with olive groves, hills and a distant village beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 1:17: a bird sees a net spread in the open.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three men crouch behind rocks and thorny shrubs beside a winding sunlit path, watching the road as a rope loops around the ankles of the man in front. Hills and a village lie in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of men lying in wait while their own snare catches one of them, reflecting Proverbs 1:18’s warning that they lurk for their own lives.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A startled traveler clutches a pouch overflowing with gold coins while a rope catches his ankle on a rocky path beside a deep ravine. Hills, trees, and a distant village fill the sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates Proverbs 1:19 by showing a person whose pursuit of gain puts his own life in danger.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a white head covering and green robe speaks with one hand extended to listeners in a sunlit stone market square, surrounded by stalls, baskets and townspeople.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom calling aloud outside and raising her voice in the open squares in Proverbs 1:20.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman gestures as she speaks beside an open stone city gate, while townspeople gather and a busy market and walled city stretch beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom crying out in the busy concourse and speaking at the city gates in Proverbs 1:21.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient town market, a woman in blue and white extends her hand as a man turns away with a raised palm; two men laugh together, while a youth rests his head on his hand.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 1:22, showing Wisdom calling as people turn away or delight in mockery.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in blue and white robes speaks with an outstretched hand to a group of listeners in a sunlit ancient town square, while golden strands of light flow among them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom calling listeners to turn at her rebuke, with the golden breeze suggesting her promise to pour out her spirit and make her words known.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient town square, a woman in white and red reaches out to passing townspeople, who continue on their way among stone buildings, baskets and market stalls.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom calling and stretching out her hand while no one pays attention, reflecting Proverbs 1:24.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone town, a woman in blue and cream reaches out to counsel a group. A man raises his hand dismissively as others turn or look away.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom's counsel and rebuke being refused in Proverbs 1:25.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A laughing woman stands apart in a sunlit ancient town square while frightened townspeople look toward a dark rainstorm over the hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom laughing at calamity as terror comes, as described in Proverbs 1:26.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Four frightened people in windblown robes huddle on a rocky path as a vast whirlwind swirls beneath dark clouds over a golden landscape, with a village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evoking the verse’s comparison of terror to a storm and destruction to a whirlwind, with distress and anguish coming upon people.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At sunrise in a stone town, a man calls out while a woman peers around a wall and another person searches farther down the street; an empty courtyard lies beyond an arch.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of calling and searching without finding, reflecting Proverbs 1:28.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village, an older man holds an open blank scroll and reaches toward four people walking away; two raise their hands in refusal. A path winds up a golden hill behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of people turning away from offered learning and an open path, reflecting Proverbs 1:29's rejection of knowledge and failure to choose the fear of Yahweh.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient town square, a robed woman reaches out as she speaks. A man raises his hand dismissively, a woman folds her arms, and an older man walks away among stone buildings and market stalls.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom offering counsel while people reject it, reflecting Proverbs 1:30 and its description of despised rebuke.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two sorrowful people eat dark, withered fruit beneath a gnarled tree beside a winding path. A basket overflows with more fruit between them, with hills and a village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of eating the fruit of their own way and being filled with their own fancies in Proverbs 1:31.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two smiling travelers in robes walk toward a crumbling cliff above a river gorge; one gestures back toward a winding path while the other walks with his hands behind his head, and rocks fall from the cliff.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of travelers turning away and walking complacently toward danger reflects Proverbs 1:32's warning about the turning away of the simple and the complacency of fools.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an older man speaks to an attentive seated man while a child sleeps beside a dog. Olive trees, village houses, and hills fill the background.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of listening and peaceful dwelling reflects Proverbs 1:33 and its promise of security without fear of evil.
